hero.title: UYCHI BUILDERS
hero.subtitle: From Uychi to the world — professional builders
hero.sceneAlt: 3D illustration of a building under construction: a crane sets the floors in place one by one
hero.goal: To train craftsmen and young people of Uychi District in modern construction trades and prepare them — with a higher-education diploma and a foreign language — for the domestic and international markets.
hero.location: NamSTU Faculty of Civil Engineering, Uychi District

problem.title: Why is this project needed?
problem.intro: Uychi District has a strong building tradition and many skilled craftsmen. Yet their potential is not being fully realised.

cards.title: Unverified qualifications.
cards.text: Many craftsmen have worked for years, yet hold no document confirming their skills. This limits their pay and their opportunities.

cards.title: The language barrier.
cards.text: Builders who go abroad without the local language end up working as general labourers on low wages instead of as qualified specialists.

cards.title: A shortage of skilled workers.
cards.text: The domestic market lacks professional builders who know modern technologies and can deliver quality, safe construction.

model.title: From craftsman to the global market
model.intro: The project runs on a five-stage chain. Each stage lays the foundation for the next.

steps.title: Engaging craftsmen
steps.text: The district's most experienced craftsmen are selected and retrained at the NamSTU Faculty of Civil Engineering in modern construction technologies.

steps.title: Mentor and apprentice
steps.text: Upskilled craftsmen become mentors, teaching young people hands-on skills on real construction sites.

steps.title: Domestic market
steps.text: First, construction in the district and the region is staffed with professional builders holding diplomas.

steps.title: Trade + language
steps.text: Alongside their trade, every builder learns a foreign language: German, Japanese, Korean or English.

steps.title: International market
steps.text: Qualified builders are placed in developed countries under international agreements, with fair wages.

model.highlight: Trade + language = a world-class professional builder.

campus.title: Campus
campus.intro: The project is based in the building of the Faculty of Civil Engineering of Namangan State Technical University.
campus.imageAlt: Building of the Faculty of Civil Engineering, Namangan State Technical University

trades.title: Core trades we teach
trades.intro: Every programme is practice-based: students learn by doing real work alongside their mentor.

items.name: Bricklayer
items.short: A solid wall is the foundation of a safe home.
items.description: Laying walls, columns and partitions from brick and block. Precise work with modern mortars and measuring tools.

items.name: Concrete worker
items.short: From foundation to roof — a master of concrete work.
items.description: Formwork preparation, pouring, compacting and curing concrete. Monolithic construction technologies.

items.name: Welder
items.description: Arc and semi-automatic welding. Steel frame and reinforcement work.
items.countries: Germany, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, UAE

items.name: Electrician
items.description: Installing a building's internal electrical networks to design, assembling switchboards, and lighting systems.

items.name: Plumber
items.short: Water and heating systems — the heart of every home.
items.description: Installing, repairing and testing water supply, drainage and heating pipework.

items.name: Tiler
items.short: Precision and taste in every tile.
items.description: Laying ceramic tiles, porcelain stoneware and mosaics on floors and walls. Modern adhesives and levelling systems.

items.name: Carpenter
items.description: Making and installing doors, window frames, roof structures and timber formwork.

items.name: Ganch carver (national craft)
items.short: A thousand-year tradition in modern architecture.
items.description: Uzbek national ganch (carved plaster) art: drawing ornaments, carving and decorating building interiors.
items.countries: Cultural sites in the UAE and other countries, restoration projects

international.title: From Uychi to the world
international.intro: Builders who master a trade and a language gain the opportunity to work as qualified specialists in developed countries.
international.globeAlt: 3D globe showing routes from Uychi District to Germany, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and the UAE

countries.name: Germany
countries.requirements: Recognition of vocational qualifications, language certificate

international.note: Work on international agreements is under way. Labour migration is carried out in accordance with the legislation of Uzbekistan, through the authorised government bodies.
